notes: Term-scoped party individual; IRI = party.uri directly. Named political parties are additionally typed members:Party; partyCode='Independent' is members:PartyGrouping only. Do not substitute or link to ontology/members#Independent; no cross-term canonical identity is asserted.
Used directly as the IRI of the members:PartyGrouping individual; no separate property needed

xsd:string; short code identifying the party (e.g. 'Fianna_Fáil'); domain members:PartyGrouping. For partyCode='Independent' retain the source term-scoped party.uri as the IRI; ontology/members#Independent is a separate general conceptual grouping.

Display name of the party (e.g. 'Fine Gael'); mapped to skos:prefLabel on the members:PartyGrouping individual. Mapping convention documented via skos:scopeNote added to members:PartyGrouping in members.owl.ttl.

Links the members:PartyGrouping individual (party.uri as subject) to the agents:HouseTerm individual (house.uri as object); domain members:PartyGrouping; range agents:HouseTerm. Phase 2 treats nested house data as a reference only: HouseTerm descriptive triples remain Houses-owned.
Reference-only HouseTerm IRI = house.uri for Phase 2 linking; do not emit HouseTerm class or descriptive triples because they remain Houses-owned.
Reference-only HouseTerm IRI used as an object link; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
xsd:integer; ordinal term number used to validate the reference HouseTerm IRI. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
xsd:string; house slug used to validate the reference HouseTerm IRI. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
Display name of the reference HouseTerm. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
